description: Cross-worker contract for turning run params into environment variables. Consumed by tests/test_param_env_contract.py (Python worker) and go-worker/internal/executor/contract_test.go (Go worker). If you change the rule, change both workers and this file together.

cases.name: no params leaves executor env untouched
params are injected under their raw key
params override a same-named executor env entry
scheduler-injected HYDRA_ keys are ordinary params
values are opaque strings (JSON, spaces, equals signs)
